purpose: Inspect the exact Neotoma chronology objects and time-control evidence for the 21 source-labelled 18-24ka positive Alnus pollen sample age records, without conflating database chronology labels with independent calibration or occupied glacial trees.

parent_source.false_positive_guard: Never silently turn radiocarbon BP into calibrated years BP or assume a source-labelled age has independent absolute age validation.

target_endpoints: GET /chronologies/{chronid} for all 11 source chronology IDs
GET /datasets/{datasetid}/chronologies for each of 6 frozen datasets
api.sample_source_type: Alnus glutinosa taxonid1299 source pollen datum; taxon label is not a species-diagnostic morphology

evaluation.reliability_bounds: Use chronology reliable AgeBoundYounger, AgeBoundOlder if present and numeric, verify lower<=upper; absent bounds -> unverified, never imputed
evaluation.calibration_controls: ChronControl records with lab number/dated material/depth/age/errors when exposed in original endpoint; do not infer zero radiocarbon controls from an endpoint that returns metadata only
evaluation.source_identity: ChronologyID fields must directly match URL chronologyid; fake ID echoed by endpoint is invalid unless metadata includes independently linked collectionunit, age bounds or controls
evaluation.multiple_models: Retain all 11 IDs, 21 samples' original chronology IDs and dataset assigned chrono lists; no selection of preferred alternative by favourable age

stopping_rule: If the API does not expose independently interpretable chronology object/controls, do not infer 21ka calibration from source label. Report source availability/metadata only and keep ancient host occupancy unverified.
note: This audit follows a negative host-specific comparison in TTF v0.5 and chocho v0.8; do not retune or reverse those outcomes.
